headline: Accepted treasurer and superintendent reports and continued discussion on a proposed bench project.
summary: The board accepted the Treasurer's report showing $86,828.48 in December income for Perpetual Care and the Superintendent's report, which noted eight burials in December and that cremains burials stopped on December 15, 2025 due to frost. Discussion on a proposed bench project continued and will be taken up at a future meeting.
decisions: Accepted the Treasurer's report showing $86,828.48 in December income for Perpetual Care; all in favor.
Accepted the Superintendent's report, including that cremains burials stopped as of December 15, 2025 due to frost conditions; all in favor.
Continued discussion on the proposed bench project to a future meeting.
plain_text:
MEETING MINUTES OF: January 21, 2026
A meeting of the Cemetery Board of Trustees was held at the Forest Dale Cemetery, 150 Forest Street, 
Malden on the above date, in accordance with the Notice of Meeting, as provided in G.L. c.30A,§§ 18-25.
Notice was filed with the City Clerk’s Office, City of Malden.
President James Tuxbury called the meeting to order at 5:00 P.M. Members present were James 
Tuxbury, Vincent Miraglia, Joseph Barriss, Sheila Fermano and Superintendent Chris Rosa.
APPROVAL OF MINUTES: The minutes of the December 17, 2025 meeting were read and upon the 
motion of Vincent Miraglia and seconded by Joseph Barriss, the Board voted to accept the minutes as 
read; all were in favor. CARRIED
CORRESPONDENCE: None
TREASURER REPORT: Cemetery Superintendent Chris Rosa provided the following information: The 
Cemetery Trust received income for the month of December in the amount of $86,828.48 for Perpetual 
Care. This money was turned over to the Treasurer’s office to be added to the Cemetery Trust accounts. 
Upon the motion of Sheila Fermano and seconded Joseph Barriss, the Board voted to accept the Trust 
Report as read; all were in favor. CARRIED
SUPERINTENDENT’S REPORT: The Superintendent’s report was received by the Trustees. 
Superintendent Rosa provided the following information:
 Burials for the month of December were as follows: five (5) existing full body burials; one (1) 
double deep and two (2) cremains for a total of eight (8) burials.
Superintend Rosa stated cremains burials were stopped as of December 15, 2025 due to frost 
conditions; leaves had been cleaned up at all cemeteries as best as possible during this past 
windy/cold weather season and the Cemetery and surrounding sidewalks had been plowed with 
great effort; Trustees were greatly appreciative and complimented the Superintendent and staff.
The motion to accept Superintendent’s report was made by Sheila Fermano and seconded by Vincent 
Miraglia; all were in favor. CARRIED
OLD BUSINESS: None
GENERAL CEMETERY BUSINESS: Continued discussion on the proposed bench project. (Will be 
further discussed at a future meeting.)
Next meeting of the Board of Trustees: The next meeting of the Cemetery Board of Trustees will be 
held on Wednesday, February 18, 2026.
ADJOURMENT: All business before the Board of Trustees having been completed and upon motion of 
Vincent Miraglis and seconded by Joseph Barriss, the meeting was adjourned at 5:30P.M.
James Tuxbury, President
Sheila L. Fermano, Secretary
Joseph Barris, Trustee
Vincent Miraglia, Trustee
